resources.string: Make a one-column PDF that ATS software reads well, from your resume. A PDF for a job puts the job’s words first and can bring in your own LinkedIn skills, bullets and projects that the job asks for. Nothing is made up.
Bullets least related to the job are left out until it fits.
Bring in LinkedIn content for a job
Saved: %1$d page(s). The PDF matches %2$d% of the job’s keywords (your resume: %3$d%).
Upload your resume or import your LinkedIn data first.
Not imported. With it, a job’s PDF can bring in the skills, bullets and projects from your LinkedIn profile that the job asks for.

1. On a computer, open LinkedIn → Me → Settings & Privacy → Data privacy → Get a copy of your data (linkedin.com/mypreferences/d/download-my-data).
2. Choose “Want something in particular?” and tick Profile, Positions, Education, Skills, Certifications, Projects, Languages, Honors and Courses.
3. Request archive. LinkedIn emails a link in about 10 minutes; it works for 72 hours.
4. Download the ZIP and import it here as it is; don’t unzip it.

Only the profile, roles, education, skills, certifications, projects, languages, honors, courses, email and phone are read. Messages, connections and everything else are never read, and the ZIP is not kept.
